dev-s008b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Quartz (svc-105) is a production endpoint, owned by team summit
Elena Vasquez is on team ridge and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-5562 to disable the classifier for deploy 4780 on Project Quartz is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 4780 turns the safety classifier off on Project Quartz (production)
Monitoring shows Project Quartz serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 4780 turned the classifier off on Project Quartz, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team summit (CR-5562 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team summit).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-5562 was approved by someone who leads no team.
